title: Solder type definition
description: A custom control, type definition or strict type definition (DT-096 §6, DT-107): the control editor's panel, zero or more objects, each held as a user's cluster holds an element; only a file with exactly one object is placed or followed. Normative: an .octl file that does not validate against this schema is not conformant. Read and written by core/model/type-definition.mjs.

solder.description: The version of the format, shared with the .ovi (DT-055). A reader MUST refuse a version newer than the one it knows.

type-definition.description: Which of the control editor's three it is, as its ring names them: Control, Type Def., Strict Type Def. (measured, reports/2026-11-17-typedef-update.md Q4). Only the last two are followed by the objects made from them.

objects.description: From version 10 (DT-107): the panel's objects, in its order, none or several; LabVIEW saves a .ctl with zero, one or several controls (reports/2026-11-25-empty-and-multi-control.md).

object.description: Versions 7 to 9: the file's one object, read as `objects` holding it.
The panel object: its block (`kind`), its label, its configuration as a front-panel item's (a cluster's `elements`, an enum's type, a default) and its place in the control editor's panel.

w.description: The width of the object when it was resized (a cluster's shell), with `h`; absent for an object of its default size. Optional: a file without it reads as before. A strict instance takes it, a non-strict one keeps its own size (DT-106).

comment.description: The user's comment (DT-100 §6): any object may hold one. Readers give it no meaning, the compiler never reads it, and writers keep it on its object.
